tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi skong ba rin po che bzhugs/ 1$0000270bla ma 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi 'o// 1$0000300

'dir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i chag nyams bskang bar 'dod na/ gtor sgrub gzhung las bshad pa ltar dkyil 'khor bca' la/ mdun du tshogs kyi mchod pa sha chen/ khrag chen/ dbang po'i me tog /gsur chen zhun chen dang*/ sgrub rdzas ci ltar bshad pa bzhin bsags la/ tshogs byin gyis brlab cing spos bsreg rol mo bsgrags la 'di skad do// hūm̐/ rang bzhin dag pa'i gzhal yas thams cad nas// rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong tshogs// 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po 'khor dang bcas// bskang ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// hūm̐/ bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po ni// sku mdog dmar po gcer bu rgyan med pa// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas dgra st+wa bsnams// g.yon pas tho ba lcags sgrog dgra rkun 'joms// 'khor du rang 'dra'i gshin rje'i tshogs kyis bskor// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs dam bskang*// g.yas nas las byed pho tshogs sprin ltar gtibs// las byed pho tshogs khyed kyi thugs dam bskang*// g.yon nas las byed mo tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs// las byed mo tshogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// mdun nas sprul pa yang sprul rlung ltar 'gyu// sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// rgyab nas chos skyong srung ma thog ltar 'beb// chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐/ khyed kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni// rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod rgya chen gyis// bla ma 'jam dpal lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// sha chen khrag chen gsur chen dang*// dbang po rnam lnga'i mchod pa dang*// phyi nang rten rdzas sgrub rdzas kyis// gshin rje 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// dgra rkun jag gsum 'khor bcas kyi// sha khrag rus dang bcas pa yis// gshin rje 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// bskangs nas bstan dgra sgrol ba dang*// dgra rkun jag gsum med par mdzod// bdag cag rnal 'byor phrin las sgrubs//

ces pas gshin rje 'khor bcas dgyes par bsam zhing dbyangs dang bcas pa bya'o// ces pa 'di yang 'jam dpal gshin rje dmar chung gi kha skong du/ tshogs mchod yod par gda' bas rung bar bsam nas rā ga a syas sbyar ba'o/// /
